name.pt: Botão de arcade de 24 mm (de encaixe)

description.en: The 24 mm snap-in arcade pushbutton class: a round button that snaps into a φ24 mm hole in a control panel up to 3.9 mm thick, a microswitch below.
description.es: La clase de botón arcade de 24 mm de presión: un botón redondo que se encaja en un barreno de φ24 mm de un panel de control de hasta 3.9 mm de espesor, con un microinterruptor debajo.
description.fr: La classe de bouton d'arcade 24 mm à clipser : un bouton rond qui se clipse dans un trou de φ24 mm d'un panneau de commande jusqu'à 3,9 mm d'épaisseur, un micro-interrupteur en dessous.
description.pt: A classe de botão de arcade de 24 mm de encaixe: um botão redondo que encaixa num furo de φ24 mm de um painel de controlo de até 3,9 mm de espessura, com um microinterruptor por baixo.

sources.title: Sanwa Denshi OBSF-24 pushbutton, official store item page
sources.supports: mounting hole φ24 ±0.1; panel 3.9 mm max

frame_convention: Origin at the centre of the bezel's underside, the face that seats on the panel's top. +z points up out of the panel, toward the player; the body and microswitch lie at z < 0 below the panel. +x is an arbitrary radial reference: the button is round.

interfaces.note: Male: the body snaps down through the panel hole and the bezel's underside seats on the panel's top face.

review_status.note: Drafted in one pass by an agent (console-hyperobjects standard-parts lane, 2026-11-01); facts read from the cited sources on the access date; no language facet has had a native review.

notes: A class entry from one maker only (Sanwa Denshi's official store pages); no second vendor's 24 mm specification could be retrieved. The cap and plunger diameters, the depth below the panel and the microswitch's tab size are not published there and are not stated.
